name: Faerie Fire
summary: Outlines objects and creatures in a 20-foot Cube in light, giving attacks against them Advantage.

stats.effect:
Objects in a 20-foot {ref:glossary/cube} within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed {ref:glossary/dim-light} in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the {ref:condition/invisible} condition.

Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have {ref:glossary/advantage} if the attacker can see it.
